question: Universal Containers (UC) is preparing to use the Agentforce Testing Center to ensure the reliability of a new agent. UC has a CSV file with test cases and is reviewing the documentation to understand best practices and limitations. Which best practice should the company follow to avoid modifying CRM data while running tests in the Testing Center?
options: Run tests in the production environment to ensure real-time data accuracy.
Limit the number of test cases to 50 per test to minimize data changes.
Use the Testing Center only in the sandbox environment.
explanation: Todas las pruebas a gran escala en Testing Center deben ejecutarse en un entorno Sandbox. Esto evita modificaciones no deseadas en los datos de producción en vivo.

question: What is the main purpose of Prompt Builder?
options: A tool for developers to use in Visual Studio Code that creates prompts for Apex programming, assisting developers in writing code more efficiently.
A tool that enables companies to create reusable prompts for large language models (LLMs), bringing generative AI responses to their flow of work
A tool within Salesforce offering real-time Al-powered suggestions and guidance to users, Improving productivity and decision-making.
explanation: El propósito de Prompt Builder es crear, probar y gestionar plantillas de prompts reutilizables para integrar IA generativa.

question: Universal Containers (UC) plans to automatically populate the Description field on the Account object. Which type of prompt template should UC use?
options: Field Generation prompt template
Flex Prompt template
Sales Email prompt template
explanation: La plantilla 'Field Generation' está diseñada específicamente para completar o actualizar campos de registros con texto generado por IA.

question: Rapid Courier Services is building an agent for package release authorization. The agent must verify a recipient's delivery code before allowing a package to be released. The team has declared a variable `code_valid` and configured a verification action. They want the package release subagent to become available only after successful verification. What is required?
options: Add an `available when: @variables.code_valid == true` guard condition to the package release subagent.
Declare `code_valid` as a constant so it cannot be altered after the agent starts.
Manually update `code_valid` to true using `@utils.setVariables` after the verification action runs.
explanation: Se utiliza la condición `available when: @variables.code_valid == true` para que el subagente se vuelva disponible. Esto hace invisible al subagente hasta que la variable se valide.

question: Everest Legal wants to ground a prompt template using the User object's related list of active client matters. What should they consider?
options: The running user must have the appropriate object-level access (e.g., "View All" or equivalent) to retrieve user-related data across the firm.
The User related list is not supported for grounding in prompt templates.
The related list must be displayed on the User record page layout for grounding to work.
explanation: El grounding respeta los permisos del usuario actual, por lo que se requiere el acceso a los datos ('View All' o equivalente) para que el retriever pueda acceder a la lista relacionada.

question: TerraLogix Supply Chain is configuring an Agentforce agent to manage warehouse access requests. A specific "Authorize Shipment Release" action must only be visible to the reasoning engine when the session variable `@variables.WarehouseCleared` is confirmed as true. An Agentforce Specialist is writing the `available when` clause in Agent Script to evaluate this condition. Which operator must the specialist use?
options: `==`, as Agent Script conditionals — including `available when` clauses — require `==` for equality comparison, distinct from the `=` operator which is reserved for variable assignment.
`=`, since Agent Script uses a unified syntax where `=` handles both value assignment and equality evaluation within conditional expressions.
Either `=` or `==` can be used interchangeably within `available when` clauses.
explanation: En Agent Script, las sentencias condicionales como `available when` requieren el uso del operador `==` para evaluar igualdad, diferenciándolo de `=` que se usa para asignaciones.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is tasked with analyzing Agent interactions, looking into user inputs, requests, and queries to identify patterns and trends. What functionality allows the Agentforce Specialist to achieve this?
options: Agent Event Logs dashboard.
AI Audit and Feedback Data dashboard.
User Utterances dashboard.
explanation: El panel de expresiones de usuario (User Utterances) está diseñado específicamente para agregar y analizar las solicitudes y conversaciones de los usuarios.

question: Which feature of the Einstein Trust Layer is designed to identify and reduce the risk of harmful or toxic outputs from generative AI?
options: Dynamic Grounding with Secure Data Retrieval
Prompt Defense
Toxicity Scoring
explanation: El Toxicity Scoring identifica y mitiga el riesgo de que la IA genere contenido dañino, asegurando que las respuestas sean seguras.

question:
Universal Containers’ data science team is hosting a generative large language model (LLM) on Amazon Web Services (AWS). 
What should the team use to access externally-hosted models in the Salesforce Platform?
options: Model Builder
App Builder
Agentforce  Builder
explanation: Model Builder conecta y gestiona modelos LLM externos alojados en plataformas como AWS dentro de Salesforce.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has effectively utilized prompt templates to update summary fields on Lightning record pages. Ant admin now wishes to incorporate similar functionality into UC's automation processes using Flow. How should the admin get a response from this prompt template from within a flow to use as part of UC's automation?
options: Invocable Apex
Einstein for Flow
Flow action
explanation: En Salesforce Flow, las plantillas de prompt se exponen como acciones invocables estándar. Esto permite integrarlas fácilmente en los procesos de automatización de la empresa.

question: Sunset Bicycle Repair launched an AI feature that auto-populates a "Diagnosis Summary" field on the Work Order object. All mechanics have the same profile, but one mechanic cannot see the generative AI sparkle icon next to the field. What is the likely cause?
options: The mechanic's profile is missing "Read" access on the Work Order object.
The mechanic does not have the "Generative AI User" permission set.
The prompt template was deactivated by mistake.
explanation: La visibilidad del ícono de inteligencia artificial para autocompletar campos requiere específicamente el conjunto de permisos 'Generative AI User'.

question: Which element in the Omni-Channel flow should be used to connect the flow with the agent?
options: Transfer to Agent element.
Assign Work element.
Route Work Action.
explanation: Route Work Action es el elemento utilizado en los flujos de Omni-Channel para dirigir el trabajo y conectar el flujo con el agente apropiado.

question: Desert Oasis Landscaping attended a home & garden expo and collected 900 new leads. They need to engage leads 24/7, answer questions about drought-tolerant plants, qualify interest, and automatically schedule design consultations — freeing human staff to focus on large projects. Which Agentforce capability meets these requirements?
options: Lead Nurturing Agent (SDR Agent)
Service Agent with automated case routing
Inventory Management Agent
explanation: El Lead Nurturing Agent (SDR Agent) está diseñado específicamente para interactuar con leads a gran volumen de forma autónoma. Se encarga de responder, calificar y agendar reuniones 24/7.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to ensure their custom agent action performs as expected in conversations. What should the Agentforce Specialist focus on when creating action instructions?
options: Write concise agent action instructions and test in Agentforce Builder.
Ensure the agent action label matches the utterance's intent.
Include comprehensive detailed descriptions and perform smoke testing.
explanation: Las instrucciones de acción deben ser concisas y probarse de forma iterativa en Agentforce Builder. Descripciones demasiado extensas pueden confundir al modelo y afectar el rendimiento del agente.

question: How does the Einstein Trust Layer ensure that sensitive data is protected while generating useful and meaningful responses?
options: Masked data will be de-masked during response journey.
Masked data will be de-masked during request journey.
Responses that do not meet the relevance threshold will be automatically rejected.
explanation: En el Einstein Trust Layer, los datos se enmascaran antes de enviarse al LLM y se desenmascaran al devolver la respuesta.

question: Universal Containers, dealing with a high volume of chat inquiries, implements Einstein Work Summaries to boost productivity. After an agent-customer conversation, which additional information does Einstein generate and fill, apart from the "summary"'
options: Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Detection
Draft Survey Request Email
Issue and Revolution
explanation: Además del resumen, Einstein Work Summaries genera campos para el 'Problema' (Issue) y la 'Resolución' (Resolution). Estos campos ayudan a entender el contexto sin revisar toda la transcripción.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to ensure the effectiveness, reliability, and trust of its agents prior to deploying them in production. UC would like to efficiently test a large and repeatable number of utterances. What should the Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Deploy the agent in a QA sandbox environment and review the Utterance Analysis reports.
Create a CSV file with UC's test cases in Agentforce Testing Center using the testing template.
Leverage the Agent Large Language Model (LLM) UI and test with different utterances.
explanation: Use un archivo CSV con casos de prueba en Agentforce Testing Center para pruebas eficientes y repetibles.

question: Universal Containers implements Custom Agent Actions to enhance its customer service operations. The development team needs to understand the core components of a Custom Agent Action to ensure proper configuration and functionality. Which component is essential for defining what the action returns?
options: Action Instructions.
Output Types.
Action Name.
explanation: Los Output Types son el componente esencial que define qué devuelve una acción personalizada. Sin ellos, el agente no puede procesar los resultados.

question: Alpine Dog Training wants its assistant to fetch real-time weather information for outdoor training sessions. How should the specialist enable web search?
options: On the General FAQ subagent, activate the "Answer Questions with Knowledge" standard action, which includes a web search option.
Delete the General FAQ subagent and create a new "Web Search" subagent with a custom action.
Build a custom search index in Data 360 and connect it to a public weather API.
explanation: Dentro del subagente de preguntas frecuentes, se debe activar la acción estándar de responder con conocimiento habilitando la opción de búsqueda web.

question: Northern Lights Soap Co. has a compliance rule that a specific prompt must use only a self-hosted Hugging Face model, never the default Salesforce LLMs. How should the specialist enforce this?
options: In Einstein Studio, register the Hugging Face model as a Bring Your Own LLM (BYOLLM), then select it in the prompt template's model picker.
Write a validation rule on the Prompt Template object that rejects any template referencing a default model.
Set an org-wide permission that disables all default models for prompt templates.
explanation: El modelo de Hugging Face se debe registrar como BYOLLM (Bring Your Own LLM) en Einstein Studio y luego seleccionarse explícitamente en el selector del template.

question: TechStart Inc. wants to deploy a Sales Development Representative (SDR) AI Agent to engage with potential customers and qualify leads. Which channel requirement should TechStart Inc. be aware of when implementing the SDR Agent?
options: The SDR Agent must be deployed through messaging channels.
The SDR Agent functions exclusively through email communications.
The SDR Agent requires deployment specifically on the corporate website's chat widget.
explanation: Un Agente SDR requiere interactuar en tiempo real, por lo que debe desplegarse a través de canales de mensajería (SMS, WhatsApp, web chat, etc.).

question: A business stakeholder wants to use AI to generate summaries based on Data Cloud data. Which methods can they use to access Data Cloud data from Prompt Builder?
options: Using Data Cloud related lists alone.
Using only external APIs to import Data Cloud data.
Accessing DMOs directly in Flex templates, using Data Cloud related lists, and fetching data via prompt-initiated flows.
explanation: Data Cloud se puede integrar nativamente en Prompt Builder usando DMOs directos en Flex templates, listas relacionadas, y flujos de iniciación de prompts.

question: A property management company's agent must check if a maintenance request is within warranty before dispatching a technician. The company wants to keep the conversation natural for tenants but ensure the warranty check always happens first. What should the specialist do?
options: Use procedural instructions in Agent Script to enforce the warranty check step before any technician dispatch action.
Move the warranty check logic into a separate agent and route all maintenance requests through that agent first.
Add a natural language instruction at the top of the subagent prompt saying "Always check warranty before dispatching."
explanation: Para garantizar que una verificación obligatoria ocurra antes de otra acción, deben usarse instrucciones de procedimiento (`->`). Estas se ejecutan de manera determinista, evitando que el LLM las omita.

question: Sunrays Limited's QA team is sizing its regression suite for the Agentforce Testing Center and asks about the practical limits and the format of expected results. What should the Agentforce Specialist tell them?
options: Each test supports up to 1,000 test cases (CSV), and expected values must use the API names of the expected topic and actions; run the suite in a sandbox.
Test cases are unlimited, and expected values are written in natural language for the LLM-as-judge to interpret.
Each test supports a maximum of 50 cases, and results must be validated manually one by one.
explanation: Testing Center admite hasta 1,000 casos de prueba por ejecución importados vía CSV, utilizando nombres de API para evaluar los valores esperados de forma determinista. Se recomienda realizar estas pruebas en un entorno sandbox.

question: A company enabled Einstein Generative AI and created a custom prompt to summarize customer feedback surveys. Users report that the summaries miss key themes and sentiments expressed in the responses. What is a likely explanation for this poor performance?
options: The prompt template version has compatibility issues with the selected language model.
The grounding data provided to the model is incomplete or lacks sufficient feedback context.
The Einstein Trust Layer is filtering out sentiment data for privacy compliance reasons.
explanation: Cuando el resumen omite detalles clave, generalmente se debe a que la información de grounding proporcionada al modelo está incompleta o carece del contexto necesario.

question: A company has built a custom action that invokes a flow to retrieve real-time inventory levels from their warehouse system. They notice the flow returns different data when triggered by the assistant versus when run manually. What should they understand about flow execution context?
options: The assistant always runs flows in system mode, so user permissions never affect returned data.
The flow respects its configured execution context — user permissions affect results if the flow runs in user context.
Flow results are determined solely by the flow logic and are never impacted by the running user's access rights.
explanation: Los flujos respetan el contexto de su ejecución; si se configuran bajo el contexto de un usuario, los resultados pueden variar según los permisos de quien invoca la acción.

question: A company is using related list merge fields in a prompt template associated with an Account object in Prompt Builder. What limitation should they consider?
options: Person accounts block merge field usage entirely.
The Activities related list on Account isn't supported because it's a polymorphic field referencing multiple object types.
If a related list is empty, the merge field prevents prompt generation entirely.
explanation: Prompt Builder no soporta campos polimórficos como la lista relacionada de Actividades (Activities) en campos de combinación.

question: A company is launching a partner portal on Experience Cloud and wants to provide partners with an agent that can answer questions about product specifications from the knowledge base and allow them to submit leads for potential customers. The agent must be accessible only to authenticated partner users. Which agent type is required?
options: Sales Agent.
Service Agent.
Commerce Agent.
explanation: Un 'Service Agent' es el tipo adecuado para portales de socios autenticados, permitiendo acceder a bases de conocimiento y ejecutar acciones.

question: A company needs a custom user interface where employees can enter an order number and receive an AI-generated summary of that order's details, including line items and shipping status. What solution should the specialist implement to meet this requirement?
options: Create a screen flow that collects the order number and invokes the prompt template using the standard prompt action.
Build an autolaunched flow triggered by record changes that generates summaries for all new orders.
Configure a template-triggered flow that automatically runs when orders reach a certain status.
explanation: Un Screen Flow permite al usuario ingresar el número de orden y luego invocar la plantilla usando la acción estándar de prompt.

question: A company needs consistent pass/fail logic for agent testing to ensure reliable validation. Which Testing Center capability provides this?
options: Structured batch testing with validation per test utterance, enabling deterministic pass/fail results.
Running scripts on event logs to analyze post-deployment behavior.
Relying on subjective customer ratings.
explanation: Las pruebas por lotes (batch testing) con validación estructurada proporcionan resultados deterministas de éxito/fracaso para cada caso de prueba.

question: What critical factors must an organization consider when deploying a multi-topic service agent with multiple actions to production?
options: Configuration freeze during deployment, which prevents changes but doesn't ensure the deployment is complete/functional.
Complete dependency coverage, adequate testing, version strategy, and explicit activation.
Deployment order optimization alone.
explanation: Para un despliegue exitoso, es crítico cubrir las dependencias, realizar pruebas adecuadas, definir la estrategia de versiones y activar los componentes explícitamente.

question:
An AI Specialist has created a Agentforce  custom action using flow as the reference action type. However, it is not delivering the expected results to the conversation preview, and therefore needs troubleshooting.
What should the AI Specialist do to identify the root cause of the problem?
options: In Agentforce  Builder within the Dynamic Panel, turn on dynamic debugging to show the inputs and outputs.
In Agentforce  Builder within the Dynamic Panel, confirm selected action and observe the values in Input and Output sections.
In Agentforce  Builder, verify the utterance entered by the user and review session event logs for debug information.
explanation: Para solucionar problemas de flujos en Agent Builder, active la depuración dinámica en el Panel Dinámico para observar entradas y salidas.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is creating a new custom prompt template to populate a field with generated output. UC enabled the Einstein Trust Layer to ensure AI Audit data is captured and monitored for adoption and possible enhancements. Which prompt template type should UC use, and what additional configuration is required?
options: Sales Email, and that the object is associated with a campaign.
Field Generation, and that Dynamic Forms is enabled.
Record Summary, and that the Lightning page is updated to Dynamic Forms.
explanation: Para rellenar campos con salidas de IA, se debe usar el tipo de plantilla Field Generation y habilitar Dynamic Forms en la página.

question: A company needs their sales representatives to be able to use existing prompt templates but must not have permission to create, modify, or delete any templates. Which permission set should the specialist assign to meet this requirement?
options: Prompt Template User, which allows execution of existing templates without modification rights.
Prompt Template Manager, which grants full creation and editing capabilities.
"Prompt Template Executor", which is not a standard permission set name.
explanation: El conjunto de permisos 'Prompt Template User' permite ejecutar plantillas existentes sin otorgar derechos de modificación.

question: A sales manager needs to contact leads at scale with hyper-relevant solutions and customized communications in the most efficient manner possible. Which Salesforce solution best suits this need?
options: Einstein Sales Assistant
Prompt Builder
Einstein Lead follow-up
explanation: Einstein Sales Assistant ofrece automatización de ventas a escala con recomendaciones personalizadas, siendo ideal para contactar leads masivamente.

question: Universal Containers’ Agent Action includes several Apex classes for the new Agentforce Agent. What is an important consideration when deploying Apex that is invoked by an Agent Action?
options: Apex classes invoked by an Agent Action may be deployed with less than 75% test coverage as long as the agent is not activated in production.
The Apex classes must have at least 75% code coverage from unit tests, and all dependencies must be in the deployment package.
The Apex classes may bypass the 75% code coverage requirement as long as they are only used by the agent.
explanation: El código Apex invocado por Agent Action requiere un 75% de cobertura y que todas sus dependencias estén en el despliegue.

question: Universal Containers deploys a new Agentforce Service Agent into the company's website but is getting feedback that the Service Agent is not providing answers to customer questions that are found in the company’s Salesforce Knowledge articles. What is the likely issue?
options: The Agentforce Service Agent user was not given the Allow View Knowledge permission set.
The Agentforce Service Agent user is not assigned the correct Agent Type License.
The Agentforce Service Agent user needs to be created under the standard Agent Knowledge profile.
explanation: Si el agente no proporciona respuestas basadas en artículos, probablemente le falte el permiso 'Allow View Knowledge'. Este permiso es fundamental para que el agente pueda recuperar y leer el contenido.

question: Universal Containers has implemented an agent that answers questions based on Knowledge articles. Which topic and action combination should be used?
options: Service Support topic and Retrieve Knowledge Action.
General FAQ topic and Answers Questions with Knowledge Action.
Knowledge Management topic and Search Knowledge Action.
explanation: La combinación ideal es un tema de General FAQ junto con la acción Answer Questions with Knowledge, diseñada para responder consultas utilizando artículos.

question:
Universal Containers (UC) uses Salesforce Service Cloud to support its customers and agents handling cases. UC is considering implementing Agentforce  and extending Service Cloud to mobile users. 
When would Agentforce  implementation be most advantageous?
options: When the goal is to streamline customer support processes and improve response times
When the main objective is to enhance data security and compliance measures
When the focus is on optimizing marketing campaigns and strategies
explanation: Agentforce es ideal para agilizar los procesos de soporte al cliente y mejorar los tiempos de respuesta.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is implementing generative AI and wants to leverage a prompt template to provide responses to customers that gives personalized product recommendations to website visitors based on their browsing history. Which initial step should UC take to ensure the chatbot can deliver accurate recommendations'
options: Design universal product recommendations.
Write a response scrip for the chatbot.
Collect and analyze browsing data.
explanation: El primer paso para ofrecer recomendaciones personalizadas es recopilar y analizar los datos de navegación del usuario. Sin esta información, la IA carece de contexto para sugerir productos relevantes.

question: A data analyst needs permissions to view and manage AI models in Einstein Studio and also create prompt templates in Prompt Builder. Which permission sets should be assigned to the data analyst?
options: Prompt Template Manager and Prompt Template User.
Data Cloud Admin and Prompt Template Manager.
Einstein Studio User and Prompt Template Manager.
explanation: El conjunto de permisos 'Data Cloud Admin' (o Activation Specialist) otorga acceso a Einstein Studio junto con 'Prompt Template Manager' para plantillas.

question: A development team needs to create a prompt template that can be invoked from a custom Visualforce page. Which prompt template type should they select?
options: Universal templates.
External Call templates.
Flex templates, general-purpose and invokable from external contexts including custom code.
explanation: Las plantillas 'Flex' son de propósito general y pueden invocarse desde contextos externos como código Apex, Visualforce o componentes Lightning.

question: A nonprofit organization uses a small development team that works exclusively with declarative tools. They need an AI agent that can prepare staff for donor meetings by summarizing giving history, highlighting interests indicated by website activity (tracked in Data Cloud), and recapping previous email and phone conversations. What approach should the consultant recommend?
options: Build and deploy a custom fine-tuned model on the organization's donor data using Einstein Studio.
Create a prompt template grounded in CRM and Data Cloud data using standard foundation models.
Implement a third-party AI service with custom API integration.
explanation: Una plantilla de prompt fundamentada en CRM y Data Cloud permite resolver este caso usando únicamente herramientas declarativas estándar.

question: An Agentforce is considering using a Field Generation prompt template type. What should the Agentforce Specialist check before creating the Field Generation prompt to ensure it is possible for the field to be enabled for generative AI?
options: That the field chosen must be a rich text field with 255 characters or more.
That the org is set to API version 59 or higher
That the Lightning page layout where the field will reside has been upgraded to Dynamic Forms
explanation: El campo destino debe estar en un diseño de página Lightning habilitado para Formularios Dinámicos para poder mostrar sugerencias generadas por IA.

question: Cloud Kicks (CK) is launching a new partner portal on Experience Cloud. CK wants to provide partners with an agent that can answer questions about product specifications from the knowledge base and allow them to submit a new Lead for a potential customer they've identified. The agent must be accessible only to authenticated partner users on the portal. Which agent type is required to meet this scenario?
options: Sales Agent
Commerce Agent
Service Agent
explanation: Service Agent es el agente adecuado para responder consultas de Knowledge y gestionar Leads en un portal autenticado. Soporta integraciones con conocimiento y acciones de CRM simultáneamente.

question: Which Einstein for Sales feature can automatically create follow-up tasks based on customer interactions and insights?
options: Einstein Activity Capture
Einstein Lead Scoring
Einstein Opportunity Insights
Einstein Task Automation
explanation: Einstein Task Automation crea de manera automática tareas de seguimiento basadas en las interacciones, optimizando el flujo de trabajo.

question: A pharmaceutical company needs their assistant to provide researchers with current drug interaction guidelines from approved clinical documents. Updates to guidelines must be reflected immediately without manual intervention. What should they implement?
options: Configure the assistant to search all clinical trial data and research papers for relevant interaction information.
Set up an Agentforce Data Library to store, index, and retrieve clinical guideline documents for AI grounding.
Manually update prompt templates with new guideline information whenever documents are revised.
explanation: Agentforce Data Library indexa y actualiza automáticamente el contenido sin intervención manual. Esto garantiza que las directrices clínicas estén siempre al día, a diferencia de otras opciones menos escalables.

question: A property management company wants to implement a triage process for maintenance requests: Emergency issues (water leaks, gas leaks) must be escalated immediately to human staff. Routine maintenance requests should create a work order automatically. The requirement demands the highest reliability and determinism in the agent's response. Which approach should the specialist recommend?
options: Use forceful keywords like "ALWAYS" and "NEVER" in instructions.
Write triage logic in Topic Instructions using conditional language.
Create a custom variable severityLevel set by a triage action, then apply action filters based on severity value for deterministic control.
explanation: El uso de una variable de severidad junto con filtros de acción permite un control determinista estricto. Esto asegura que las emergencias se escalen inmediatamente sin depender de la interpretación del LLM.

question: A developer needs to create a custom action that performs complex calculations, queries multiple objects, and updates records based on business rules. What implementation option should they choose for this custom action?
options: Apex triggers that fire when related records are created or updated.
SOQL queries embedded directly in the action configuration.
Flows that can be invoked by the assistant to execute the required logic.
explanation: Los Flows permiten ejecutar lógica compleja, consultas y actualizaciones de registros de manera declarativa y pueden ser invocados por el agente.

question: A sales director asks their AI assistant, "Show me all deals that are close to closing this quarter." The assistant then displays a list of opportunities with high probability scores and upcoming close dates. What process enables the assistant to understand the request and take the correct action?
options: The language model interprets the natural language request, creates an execution plan identifying relevant topics and actions, then runs those actions to retrieve and display the information.
The assistant uses a predefined mapping of keywords to actions.
The assistant follows a fixed dialog script with menus.
explanation: El LLM interpreta la solicitud en lenguaje natural y crea un plan de ejecución identificando las acciones necesarias. Agentforce no utiliza menús fijos ni un simple mapeo de palabras clave.

question: Universal Containers wants to leverage the Record Snapshots grounding feature in a prompt template. What preparations are required?
options: Configure page layout of the master record type.
Create a field set for all the fields to be grounded.
Enable and configure dynamic form for the object.
explanation: Record Snapshots obtiene los datos para el prompt únicamente de los campos presentes en el Page Layout del tipo de registro maestro. Por ello, es necesario configurar este diseño para definir qué información técnica precisa se enviará al modelo.

question: How does the LLM in Agentforce utilize user interaction data to improve its actions?
options: By creating new user profiles based on interaction data
By increasing the number of available actions
By adjusting the CRM system’s security settings
explanation: El LLM se apoya en los perfiles y las interacciones previas del usuario para proporcionar respuestas y acciones más efectivas.

question: A sales team wants to use AI to dynamically suggest products from their catalog based on customer requirements expressed during conversations. Which type of prompt template is best suited for this use case?
options: Record Summary template.
Flex prompt template, which can dynamically incorporate catalog data and adapt to conversation context.
"Email Generation" template.
explanation: Las plantillas Flex permiten incorporar dinámicamente datos del catálogo y adaptarse al contexto de la conversación. Son ideales para generar sugerencias de productos en tiempo real.

question: Universal Containers has deployed Agentforce to handle customer order tracking, returns, and loyalty support. The agent needs to balance conversational flexibility for customer inquiries with guaranteed execution of identity verification steps before accessing the account information. The development team is evaluating how to structure the agent's instruction pattern to meet both requirements. Which statement correctly describes hybrid reasoning in Agentforce Agent Script?
options: Hybrid reasoning uses multiple large language model (LLM) models simultaneously, with one model handling conversational responses and another model executing deterministic business logic through Flow integration.
Hybrid reasoning requires Canvas View for declarative instructions and Script View for procedural instructions, as each editor provides different capabilities for the respective instruction types.

Hybrid reasoning combines declarative natural language instructions that allow large language model (LLM) interpretation with procedural instructions using the '->' prefix that enforce guaranteed execution order.
explanation: El razonamiento híbrido en Agent Script permite combinar lenguaje natural flexible con instrucciones procedimentales (->) para pasos deterministas.

question: A Salesforce administrator at FinTech Solutions is configuring prompt templates for their AI implementation. While testing a prompt template in the preview mode, the administrator notices two separate text sections labeled "Resolution" and "Response" in the output display. What information is displayed in the Resolution section?
options: The final processed content that gets sent to the Einstein Trust Layer for validation.
The initial output generated by the language model before any processing.
A list of personally identifiable information that was detected and masked.
explanation: La sección Resolution muestra el contenido final procesado del prompt con los campos combinados antes de enviarse al LLM. Por otro lado, Response muestra la salida generada por el modelo.

question: Which of the following is a core feature of the Einstein Trust Layer that ensures data privacy?
options: Data Anonymization
Data Encryption
Role-Based Access Control
Multi-factor Authentication
explanation: La encriptación de datos asegura su privacidad convirtiéndolos a un formato seguro contra accesos no autorizados.

question: When creating a prompt template that includes grounding data, what factor must an administrator consider regarding the selected AI model?
options: The model's geographic data residency requirements.
The model's training data cutoff date.
The model's input token limit must accommodate both instructions and grounding data to prevent truncation of important context.
explanation: Es esencial considerar que el límite de tokens del modelo debe ser suficiente para incluir tanto las instrucciones como los datos de anclaje (grounding). Si se supera este límite, se trunca información clave y la calidad de la respuesta disminuye.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is discussing its AI strategy in an agile Scrum meeting. Which business requirement would lead an Agentforce Specialist to recommend connecting to an external foundational model via Einstein Studio (Model Builder)?
options: UC wants to fine-tune model temperature.
UC wants a model fine-tuned using company data.
UC wants to change the frequency penalty of the model.
explanation: Usar Model Builder para un modelo externo es ideal cuando se requiere un modelo ajustado con datos propios de la empresa. Otros ajustes menores se pueden realizar en Model Playground.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to limit an agent’s access to Knowledge articles while deploying the "Answer Questions with Knowledge" action. How should UC achieve this?
options: Define scope instructions to the agent specifying a list of allowed article titles or IDs.
Update the Data Library Retriever to filter on a custom field on the Knowledge article.
Assign Data Categories to Knowledge articles, and define Data Category filters in the Agentforce Data Library.
explanation: Para limitar el acceso, se deben asignar Categorías de Datos a los artículos y aplicar filtros de categoría en la Biblioteca de Datos de Agentforce.

question: After an agent selects a topic, what is an important factor the reasoning engine uses to select the specific action?
options: Priority values, which influence but don't guarantee selection.
The name and instructions of the actions, which provide critical context for matching user intent to the right action.
The explicit order of actions, which may influence presentation but isn't the primary factor.
explanation: El motor de razonamiento utiliza el nombre y las instrucciones de la acción para emparejar la intención del usuario con la acción correcta. Son la señal principal, muy por encima de los valores de prioridad.
